phase: Reusable Batch Attributed Relationship Economics Views
objective: Make bounded multi-relationship attributed economics views a reusable application layer so reporting can load a cohort once and derive multiple aggregate projections without repeating D1 reads.
rules: The caller supplies an explicit finite relationship ID set.
Requested relationship IDs are canonicalized and deduplicated before persistence reads.
Requested relationship order is preserved in the returned view array.
Empty input returns an empty view array without persistence reads.
Returned presentations and economic facts must belong to the requested cohort.
At most one insurance presentation may exist per requested relationship.
Relationships with no presentation remain represented with absent presentation context.
Relationships with no economics facts remain represented with an empty canonical analytics projection.
Relationship economics are created only through createInsuranceRelationshipAcquisitionAnalytics.
INS-003J delegates relationship-view construction to this application.
No view or aggregate result is persisted.
